name: brief-by-default-cli-outputs
title: Brief-by-default CLI outputs for agent-loop context hygiene
description: Forensic evidence (2026-07-12, rollout 019f46ea turn-40): in a 383-call agentic turn, single large CLI outputs are cache-re-read by every later model call. Measured offenders: story_advance appends the full milestone-ledger markdown table (~8.4k tokens, printed 3x in one turn), finding_list with populated findings (~10.2k tokens), lattice help (~50KB / ~12.6k tokens). Fresh audit on 0.3.185 also found story_list default dump = 365KB (~91k tokens) and global bug_list = 263KB (~66k tokens). One 10k-token output early in a turn amplified to ~3.8M tokens of ledger-visible volume. Goal: make these commands print a compact, actionable summary by default, with an explicit flag for the full output, honoring a LATTICE_BRIEF_OUTPUT=0 environment escape hatch. Explicit machine-consumer JSON opt-ins (--json / --format=json) keep their current shape. This is agent-loop context hygiene only: no gate behavior change, gateEvidence semantics untouched. Note: validate already uses --full to mean run-real-machine-tests, so the new full-output flag must not collide with that semantics on validate.

riskSignalsDismissed.reason: False positive keyword match: the story text uses token exclusively to mean LLM context tokens (output size measured in tokens, e.g. ~8.4k tokens of markdown table). No credentials, secrets, auth tokens, or security-sensitive material are read, written, or rendered by this story; it changes CLI output verbosity only.
